title: Pronunciation and vocabulary (Theme 10: Safety)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child listens for the sound (a, or, ee, oo, oi, ay), says it back, and matches it to the right word or picture.

floor.prerequisite: Hears the first sound of a word.
floor.question: Does "pool" start like "pull"?

steps: Say it in three words with pictures.
Say two words that differ by one sound; the child points.
contexts: a boy at the zebra crossing

board.do: Wait for the child to point.
The child says the word back and traces its first letter.
Write pool and underline the sound.

checks.question: Which word has the sound in "boy": toy, top, tea?
Which word has the sound in "day": play, pen, pan?
